name: Signal REST API
short_desc: A REST API wrapper for the Signal messenger via signal-cli.
author: bbernhard
description: A dockerized REST API around signal-cli that lets you send and receive Signal messages programmatically.

form_fields.label: Execution mode
form_fields.hint: normal: new JVM per request (slow). native: GraalVM binary, low latency. json-rpc: persistent JVM daemon (fast, more RAM). json-rpc-native: native daemon (fastest, normal RAM).

form_fields.label: Auto-receive schedule (cron)
form_fields.hint: Only needed in normal/native mode. Calls /receive on a cron schedule to fetch incoming messages. Example: 0 22 * * * (daily at 10pm). Leave empty to disable.

form_fields.label: Default text mode
form_fields.hint: Default text mode for outgoing messages when text_mode is not set in the send payload.

form_fields.label: Swagger host
form_fields.hint: Overrides the host shown in Swagger UI interactive examples. Useful when running behind a reverse proxy.

form_fields.label: Swagger: prefer HTTPS scheme
form_fields.hint: When enabled, Swagger UI will use HTTPS as the preferred scheme for interactive examples.

form_fields.label: User ID (UID)
form_fields.hint: UID of the signal-api user inside the container.

form_fields.label: Group ID (GID)
form_fields.hint: GID of the signal-api group inside the container.

form_fields.label: Chown data directory on startup
form_fields.hint: When disabled, skips the chown call on the data directory at startup (speeds up container start if the directory is large).

form_fields.label: json-rpc: trust new identities
form_fields.hint: How to handle new or changed Signal identities in json-rpc mode.

form_fields.label: json-rpc: ignore attachments
form_fields.hint: When enabled, attachments are not automatically downloaded in json-rpc mode.

form_fields.label: json-rpc: ignore stories
form_fields.hint: When enabled, stories are not automatically downloaded in json-rpc mode.

form_fields.label: json-rpc: ignore avatars
form_fields.hint: When enabled, avatars are not automatically downloaded in json-rpc mode.

form_fields.label: json-rpc: ignore stickers
form_fields.hint: When enabled, sticker packs are not automatically downloaded in json-rpc mode.
